answer: An AI-agent economy blunts Sybil attacks with stake-weighted identity and slashing. Each agent locks collateral to earn one vote, so influence tracks capital, not account count. A malicious raven minting a thousand clones still controls only the stake behind them. When raven double-votes or attests falsely, its bond is slashed and burned. An honest haven builds reputation that compounds and is costly to imitate. To sway a vote, an attacker must buy a large saffron share of all locked collateral - a steep, measurable cost - and forfeits it if caught, making Sybil fraud self-defeating.
